title: Oct 2, 2026AnnouncementsAnthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap
summary: Announcements Anthropic invests $100 million to train 10,000 engineers and tackle the enterprise AI talent gap Oct 2, 2026 Learn more The first-of-its-kind Academy trains Frontier Deployed Engineers using the same standard of skills as Anthropic’s own engineers, starting with cohorts from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley, Novo Nordisk and others. Today we are launching Claude Frontier Academy to solve one of the most pressing issues in AI implementation: talent. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers (FDEs) by the end of 2027. Engineers from Accenture, Bain, Capgemini, Commonwealth Bank of Australia, Deloitte, McKinsey, Morgan Stanley and Novo Nordisk are in the first cohorts. Every enterprise is racing to bring AI into its organization, but the people with the skills to make it work inside a real business have become the hardest talent to find. Inside the companies we work with, a small group of deeply skilled people drives an outsized share of what AI delivers. The Academy is the first of its kind from an AI company, built from our own work deploying Claude inside the world’s largest enterprises and the professional services organizations that serve them. “A small team of high-agency people with the right skills, access to Claude, and a deep understanding of how their business runs can transform an entire company. The hard part is building that depth of talent, engineers with the highest level of AI fluency who can take Claude from an idea to a system in production and turn it into faster processes and new products and services. No AI company has invested in developing that talent inside its customers and partners at this depth. Claude Frontier Academy trains people the way our own engineers learn, and we want those who graduate to set the standard for how AI gets built inside a business.” – Steve Corfield, Global Head of Business Development and
title_es: Anthropic invierte $100M para formar 10k engineers en IA
bajada: Anthropic lanzó Claude Frontier Academy con un compromiso de $100 millones para entrenar 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers para 2027, abordando la escasez crítica de talento en implementación empresarial de IA. El programa capacita con los mismos estándares que usan los propios engineers de Anthropic.
bajada_en: Anthropic launched Claude Frontier Academy with a $100 million commitment to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by 2027, addressing the critical talent shortage in enterprise AI implementation. The program trains using the same standards as Anthropic's own engineers.

title: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB Gives Developers More Ways to Build and Scale Local AI
summary: Local AI is becoming more useful by the token. As AI agents move from experiments into everyday development, increasingly capable open models are shrinking to fit on more devices, giving builders more to run locally.  Coming this month, NVIDIA DGX Spark will be available with 64GB of unified memory from top manufacturer partners — Acer, […]
title_es: NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB democratiza IA local
bajada: NVIDIA anunció que DGX Spark estará disponible con 64GB de memoria unificada este mes, permitiendo a developers ejecutar modelos de IA cada vez más capaces en dispositivos locales. Esta expansión facilita que los agentes de IA pasen de experimentos a desarrollo cotidiano.
bajada_en: NVIDIA announced DGX Spark with 64GB unified memory available this month, enabling developers to run increasingly capable AI models locally on more devices. This expansion makes it easier for AI agents to move from experiments to everyday development.

For developers, […]
title_es: GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast genera tokens 8x más rápido
bajada: OpenAI lanzó GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast en la API, optimizado para NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, ofreciendo generación de tokens hasta 8 veces más rápida que el modo Standard. La mejora de velocidad es crítica para aplicaciones de tiempo real y agentes conversacionales.
bajada_en: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra Ultrafast on the API, optimized for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, delivering token generation up to 8x faster than Standard mode. The speed improvement is critical for real-time applications and conversational agents.

title: Meta wants you to build your own Muse gadget
summary: Meta wants Muse in your TV and your toaster, so it's giving the code away for free.
title_es: Meta abre código de Muse para crear gadgets IA propios
bajada: Meta liberó el código fuente de su agente IA Muse para que developers creen gadgets personalizados, desde displays E Ink hasta sticks HDMI. Esta estrategia de open-source permite a la comunidad experimentar con agentes IA en hardware diverso.
bajada_en: Meta open-sourced its Muse AI agent to let developers build custom gadgets, from E Ink displays to HDMI sticks. This open-source strategy enables the community to experiment with AI agents across diverse hardware.

title: OpenAI’s Dot agent is enterprise software that can also order your dinner
summary: It's a tale as old as last week: OpenAI's new agent platform, called Dots, is full of cute little guys who can do your bidding. But unlike the ultra-approachable Meta Muse, Dots feel very much like using workplace software that happens to be able to order you a burrito - emphasis on work. OpenAI announced […]
title_es: OpenAI presenta Dots, agente empresarial que ordena comida
bajada: OpenAI anunció Dots, una plataforma de agentes enfocada en software empresarial con capacidades de automatización de tareas cotidianas como pedir comida. A diferencia de Meta Muse, Dots se posiciona como herramienta productiva para el entorno laboral.
bajada_en: OpenAI announced Dots, an agent platform focused on enterprise software with capabilities like automating everyday tasks such as ordering food. Unlike Meta Muse, Dots is positioned as a productivity tool for workplace environments.

title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
summary: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.
title_es: Apple refuerza controles de acceso por riesgos de agentes IA
bajada: Apple anunció nuevos controles para Full Disk Access en macOS, preocupada por los riesgos que presentan los agentes IA cada vez más capaces que podrían acceder a archivos, mensajes y datos de navegación de usuarios. La medida refleja la creciente necesidad de seguridad granular.
bajada_en: Apple announced new Full Disk Access controls for macOS, concerned about risks from increasingly capable AI agents accessing files, messages, and browsing data. The measure reflects growing need for granular security in AI-enabled systems.

summary: AI cloud company Lambda said it has secured its first delayed draw term loan at over $1 billion to purchase more than 30,000 Nvidia graphics processing units. The fixed-rate facility carries an interest rate of 6.78%.Privately held Lambda said in an announcement late on Thursday the facility ...
title_es: Lambda asegura $1B en GPUs a través de préstamo
bajada: Lambda Cloud obtuvo un préstamo de $1 mil millones para comprar más de 30,000 GPUs NVIDIA a tasa fija de 6.78%. El movimiento refleja la creciente inversión en infraestructura GPU para sostener la demanda de IA en la nube.
bajada_en: Lambda Cloud secured a $1 billion loan to purchase over 30,000 NVIDIA GPUs at a fixed rate of 6.78%. The move reflects growing investment in GPU infrastructure to sustain cloud AI demand.

title: NVIDIA /OpenShell
summary:
Important New in OpenShell 0.1.x: a stable release cadence, new isolation primitives, an expanded extension surface, and new APIs. Read the 0.1.0 upgrade guide . OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents. Agents are most useful when they can read files, install packages, call APIs, and use credentials. OpenShell gives them that capability without giving them unrestricted access to your data, secrets, or network. You declare what each agent can touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it. How It Works OpenShell governs what agents can do in two ways: it instruments the kernel to enforce policy on every file access, system call, and network connection at runtime, and it uses formal verification to check what a policy change would allow before it is applied. Kernel-level enforcement. Each agent runs in an isolated sandbox. Kernel controls confine which files it can access and which system calls it can make, and every network connection passes through a policy check before it leaves the sandbox. Agents never see real credentials; OpenShell adds them only to requests bound for approved endpoints. Formally verified policy changes. Before a policy change is approved, OpenShell uses formal verification to flag risky new access it would grant, such as reaching a new host with credentials or calling a new API method, so those changes wait for human review. See Architecture for how the gateway, supervisor, and sandbox fit together. Quickstart You need Linux, macOS on Apple Silicon, or Windows with WSL 2 (experimental), plus Docker, Podman, or host virtualization. See the Support Matrix for details. curl -LsSf https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NVIDIA/OpenShell/main/install.sh | sh

title_es: NVIDIA OpenShell 0.1: runtime seguro para agentes IA
bajada: NVIDIA lanzó OpenShell 0.1, runtime de código abierto que permite a agentes IA autónomos acceder a archivos y APIs de forma segura mediante políticas granulares y aislamiento de kernel. La versión estable introduce verificación formal y nuevas primitivas de aislamiento.
bajada_en: NVIDIA released OpenShell 0.1, an open-source runtime enabling autonomous AI agents to safely access files and APIs through granular policies and kernel isolation. The stable release introduces formal verification and new isolation primitives.

title: A model guide for the GPT-6 family
summary: Learn how startups can choose GPT-6 models, tune reasoning effort, improve prompts and skills, coordinate tools, and prepare workflows for production.
title_es: OpenAI publica guía práctica para GPT-6
bajada: OpenAI lanzó una guía completa para que startups y developers aprovechen la familia GPT-6, cubriendo desde la selección de modelos hasta optimización de prompts y preparación para producción. La guía ayuda a los equipos a maximizar el valor de los nuevos modelos en workflows reales.
bajada_en: OpenAI released a comprehensive guide for startups and developers to leverage the GPT-6 family, covering model selection, prompt optimization, and production readiness. The guide helps teams maximize value from the new models in real-world workflows.

title: Meta open sources code to let you make Muse AI gadgets
summary: Meta now lets you make your own Muse gadgets that feature the company's new AI agent with code that the company open sourced. The company suggests projects like loading Muse on a color E Ink display to show reminders, adding it to an HDMI stick so you can display Muse on a big screen, or […]
title_es: Meta open source Muse para dispositivos personalizados
bajada: Meta liberó el código de Muse permitiendo crear agentes IA en dispositivos propios como displays E Ink o HDMI sticks. La iniciativa democratiza el acceso a agentes IA sofisticados para hardware personalizado.
bajada_en: Meta open-sourced Muse enabling developers to create AI agents on custom devices like E Ink displays or HDMI sticks. The initiative democratizes access to sophisticated AI agents for personalized hardware.

title: Open-sourcing AstaBrief, the fast report-generation model in Asta
title_es: Hugging Face libera AstaBrief para generación de reportes
bajada: Hugging Face publicó AstaBrief, modelo de generación de reportes rápido de la familia Asta, en open-source. La herramienta permite a developers crear automáticamente reportes estructurados de forma eficiente.
bajada_en: Hugging Face released AstaBrief, a fast report-generation model from the Asta family, as open-source. The tool enables developers to efficiently create structured reports automatically.

title: AutoSynthData: Generating Training Data for Enterprise Agents
title_es: ServiceNow y Hugging Face presentan AutoSynthData
bajada: ServiceNow lanzó AutoSynthData en colaboración con Hugging Face, una solución para generar automáticamente datos de entrenamiento para agentes empresariales. Esto reduce la fricción en crear conjuntos de datos personalizados para entrenamientos específicos.
bajada_en: ServiceNow launched AutoSynthData with Hugging Face, a solution to automatically generate training data for enterprise agents. This reduces friction in creating custom datasets for domain-specific training.

title: OpenAI Hires Top Trump AI Official to Work on National Security
summary: OpenAI is continuing to fill out its leadership bench with former Trump administration officials.Thomas Lind, who previously led AI policy at the Office of the National Cyber Director, joinedOpenAIthis week, an OpenAI spokesperson confirmed. ONCD is a key office within the White House that played a leading role in putting together a June executive order on AI.Lind will lead cyber and strategic risk on OpenAI’s national security policy team, which is led by Sasha Baker, the former deputy Under Secretary of Defense for Policy in the Biden administration.
title_es: OpenAI contrata funcionario de seguridad nacional de Trump
bajada: OpenAI contrató a Thomas Lind, ex líder de política IA en la Oficina del Ciberdefensor Nacional, para dirigir riesgos de seguridad cibernética. El movimiento continúa el patrón de OpenAI de traer expertos en política de seguridad nacional.
bajada_en: OpenAI hired Thomas Lind, former AI policy lead at the Office of the National Cyber Director, to head cyber and strategic risk. The move continues OpenAI's pattern of recruiting national security policy experts.

title: These AI Experts Want to Do High-Stakes Research Out in the Open
summary: Many frontier labs keep their risky research locked away. Trillium Labs wants to show off its work when it comes to self-improvement and model behavior.
title_es: Trillium Labs investiga IA de alto riesgo en abierto
bajada: Trillium Labs desafía el modelo tradicional de laboratorios fronterizos decidiendo publicar su investigación de alto riesgo sobre auto-mejora y comportamiento de modelos. La aproximación apunta a mayor transparencia en temas críticos de seguridad de IA.
bajada_en: Trillium Labs challenges the traditional approach of frontier labs by deciding to publish its high-risk research on self-improvement and model behavior. The approach aims for greater transparency on critical AI safety topics.

title: A Flaw in ChatGPT’s Mac App Could Have Let Hackers Grab Sensitive Data
summary: While the focus has been on AI agents’ hacking capabilities, a recently patched vulnerability in a ChatGPT app shows that AI software is itself an inviting—and vulnerable—target.
title_es: Falla en ChatGPT Mac podría haber expuesto datos sensibles
bajada: Investigadores descubrieron una vulnerabilidad en la app de ChatGPT para Mac que fue parcheada y habría permitido a atacantes acceder a datos sensibles. El hallazgo subraya que software de IA es objetivo atractivo para exploits, no solo ejecutor de ataques.
bajada_en: Researchers discovered a patched vulnerability in ChatGPT's Mac app that could have let attackers access sensitive data. The finding highlights that AI software is an attractive target for exploits, not just an executor of attacks.
